Inside NCAA Division I Softball Hitting (2021–2022)

Exploring Contact, Power, Speed, and the Transfer Portal Across 302 College Programs

Welcome! What makes an elite college softball offense—putting the bat on the ball, swinging for the fences, stealing every base in sight, or landing a star from the transfer portal? Using 4,406 individual player-seasons across 302 NCAA Division I programs from the 2021 and 2022 seasons, this site lets you dig into the stories and interactive tools behind modern college softball hitting.

College Softball’s Best Lineups (2021–2022)

Before diving into individual players, hover over the bars below to see the 15 strongest single-season college lineups of 2021 and 2022, ranked by plate-appearance-weighted OPS (On-Base Plus Slugging, which combines getting on base with hitting for extra bases). Back-to-back national champion Oklahoma holds the top two spots by a wide margin.

Explore the Site

Pick any tab in the navigation bar—or jump straight in below:

  • Players (Interactive Explorer): Search all 3,200+ players and 302 colleges across 2021 and 2022, complete with school crests, transfer badges, and combined career lines.
  • Hitting Graphs (Interactive Explorer): Test how strikeouts (K) affect batting average (BA) across both seasons and hover to inspect outliers.
  • Power Hitting (Data Story): Discover why home-run power normally costs strikeouts—and how Oklahoma’s Jocelyn Alo and Tiare Jennings broke that rule completely.
  • Transfers & Breakouts (Story + Explorer): Follow the 72 players who switched Division I colleges between 2021 and 2022, compare them with 1,063 returning teammates, and browse the biggest year-over-year breakouts.
  • Speed & Power (Story + Explorer): See why college runners succeed on 83.5% of steal attempts on 60-foot basepaths, and meet the ultra-rare “15 HR / 15 SB” club.
